study.name: Account engagement state and initial post performance
study.hypothesis: Higher pre-publication account engagement is associated with higher initial post engagement and/or reach.
study.account_window_analysis: Compares the last 7 days, the previous 7 days and the full available history.
study.weighted_ir_definition: Total interactions divided by total reach.
study.mean_ir_definition: Simple mean of publication-level interaction rates.
study.last_7d_contribution_definition: Share of all observed reach, views and interactions generated by publications in the last 7 days.
study.causality_warning: This is an observational analysis and does not establish causality.
